plainTranslation: Their sensitivity to old wounds lands directly on how you present yourself and enter situations, making vulnerable parts of your self-image easier to notice.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
summaryShort: Their sensitivity to old wounds lands directly on how you present yourself and enter situations, making vulnerable parts of your self-image easier to notice.
summaryDeep: Their sensitivity to old wounds lands directly on how you present yourself and enter situations, making vulnerable parts of your self-image easier to notice. You may feel recognized in a tender place, or exposed if their attention reaches it before trust is established. This contact can bring an injury into view, but it does not promise that either person will heal it.
